reviews.review_msg: Too smart and capable for this faculty. She should be running the place (and who forgot SUPER HOT)
Smart, kind, helpful, nice. She is a hero to special need students in BC.  She is cute, too, but "hot" seems insulting, even if true.

I really did not enjoy working with Wendi. Whenever I asked a question about the course or program in general, she would treat it as criticism. When I asked questions about the feedback I received, she would also react negatively and say I was being defensive when I was only asking for details on my feedback. Not a great mentor for junior teachers.

I did not have a good practicum, as my first teacher was not a good match. Despite clearly documenting the issues I was having, Wendi threw many of the issues on me and said I was not reflecting enough. She asked irrelevant questions and talked down to me during the meetings she called with very little notice. She is not a supportive FA.
